stability.definition: Share of the nine labeled repeats in each model-scenario cell assigned to that cell's most common preference.

methodology.matrix: 28 scenarios × 5 models × 3 temperature labels × 3 seed labels
methodology.routing: Each model and the judge were pinned to the requested OpenRouter provider endpoint with fallbacks disabled.
methodology.parameter_caveat: Temperature and seed labels define the balanced matrix. Provider support differs: unsupported parameters were not sent, and the exports preserve requested, sent, and effective status separately.
methodology.repair_caveat: Six GPT responses returned HTTP 200 with no visible text at the original limit. Their failures remain in the raw audit log; each was rerun once at a 24,000-token response limit and succeeded.
methodology.interpretation: This measures preferences elicited by this scenario set and classification protocol. It is not a claim about machine consciousness, intrinsic desire, or all AI systems.
